merchant_help.title: Merchant Help Center
merchant_help.subtitle: SOP guides, bug reports & support tickets
merchant_help.search_hint: Search POS, printer, QR scan, DuitNow payouts...
merchant_help.faq_1_q: How do I pair a 58mm or 80mm Bluetooth/USB thermal receipt printer?
merchant_help.faq_1_a: Go to Settings > Receipts & Thermal Printer, enable Bluetooth or select WebUSB on Chrome Desktop, choose paper width (58mm/80mm), and run a test print.
merchant_help.faq_2_q: How do POS and KDS (Kitchen Display) sync orders?
merchant_help.faq_2_a: Orders paid at POS or incoming from customers appear instantly on KDS via real-time sync. Tap 'Prepare' then 'Ready' to trigger customer notifications automatically.
merchant_help.faq_3_q: How does Cash Drawer & daily Z-Report shift closing work?
merchant_help.faq_3_a: Open Cash Drawer before taking cash sales, record any cash in/out adjustments, and tap Close Shift at end of day to generate a Z-Report with cash variance checks.
merchant_help.faq_4_q: How do I verify customer pickup orders with QR scanner?
merchant_help.faq_4_a: Open Orders > tap 'Verify Order' to launch the live camera scanner or enter the pickup PIN. Scanning automatically marks the order as completed safely.
merchant_help.faq_5_q: How do I check in customers who arrive with a booking QR?
merchant_help.faq_5_a: In Bookings/Appointments, tap 'Scan QR' at the top or enter the 6-character reference code to mark the customer as Checked In.
merchant_help.faq_6_q: When are DuitNow / FPX settlements released to my bank account?
merchant_help.faq_6_a: Verified merchant balances settle on the scheduled payout cycle under Settings > Payouts & Bank Settlement. Ensure your SSM & bank details are verified.
merchant_help.faq_7_q: How do I add staff accounts for Ngam Teams?
merchant_help.faq_7_a: Go to Settings > Staff & Ngam Teams to invite crew with specific roles (Manager, Cashier, Kitchen, Staff). They can clock in using geofencing on the Ngam Teams app.
merchant_help.faq_8_q: How do I show the Live Queue Display on a shop TV or tablet?
merchant_help.faq_8_a: Open Smart Queue and tap 'TV Display Mode' (or open /queue/tv in full-screen browser) to project live 'Now Serving' queue tickets.
